episodes.title: Parte 1
episodes.summary: Feeling suffocated by his family, Patrick ventures out to a cabin in the woods seeking solitude, but he's met with an attractive temptation.

episodes.title: Parte 2
episodes.summary: The drugs Patrick takes evoke painful memories and cause him to have multiple disturbing visions of his family.

episodes.title: Parte 3
episodes.summary: Patrick is distraught by his concern for Mencía and heads home to find her. What ensues is a change for his family.
